title: Knowledge Wiring + Decision Architecture + Conversational Output
brief: Wire 3,831 tribal tips, 296 playbook rules, 591K manufacturer data, 22 unused KB functions, 109 reasoning engines, and 47 post-processor engines into ALL pipeline decision points. Build TribalKnowledgeActionEngine (200 actionable rules). Build ConversationalOutputEngine (Mazatrol/AOT/VQC).

units.title: Build TribalKnowledgeDecisionBridge (~400L)
units.description: Thin integration: takes decision context {material_iso, operation, strategy, controller, tool_type, feature_type} → queries TribalKnowledgeEngine (3,831 tips) + MachiningPlaybookEngine (296 rules) + controller-knowledge-tips + academy courses → returns actionable modifiers. Wire to calcDispatcher: tribal_decision_query.

units.title: Build TribalKnowledgeActionEngine — convert 200 tips to rules (~600L)
units.description: Convert top 200 tribal tips from text to actionable rules with applies_when conditions + action parameter modifiers. 50 turning, 50 milling, 30 5-axis, 20 grinding, 20 EDM, 15 laser, 15 waterjet. Each rule: applies_when:{iso?,operation?,strategy?} action:{parameter,operation:'set'|'multiply',value}.

units.title: Wire TribalKnowledgeBridge into PipelineDecisionOrchestrator
units.description: In E1080.decide(): after scoring candidates, call Bridge.query(context) + ActionEngine.apply(candidates). Tips modify scores. Playbook violations penalize. Applied tips in justification[].
exit_conditions: Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

units.title: Build ConversationalOutputEngine — Mazatrol/AOT/VQC (~800L)
units.description: Three formatters: Mazatrol UNIT+SHAPE (use 22 strategies from MultiCamStrategyEngineExt), Okuma AOT guidance (from controller-knowledge-tips), Haas VQC guidance. Wire to camDispatcher.

units.title: Wire 22 unused KB functions into TurningPrintToProgram
units.description: Replace hardcoded selectInsert() with KB's selectInsertGeometry(). Wire: BORING_BAR_RULES, GROOVING_PARTING_RULES, CSS_G97_LOGIC, THREADING_INFEED, COOLANT_MATRIX, SAFE_START_BLOCKS, PECK_RULES, TURRET_INDEX_TIMES, analyzeTurningChatter, analyzeHardTurning. Remove 9 dead imports.

units.title: Wire manufacturer speed/feed data into UltimateSpeedFeedEngine
units.description: Replace inline ISO-group-average tables with manufacturer-specific data from guhring-iscar-speed-feed-data.ts, helical-speed-feed-data.ts, osg-speed-feed-data.ts, manufacturer-speed-feed-data.ts (2,423 lines total). When tool brand known, use brand-specific data.
exit_conditions: Manufacturer-specific S/F returned when brand known
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

units.title: Wire hyperMILL materials (2,544) into material resolution
units.description: When SpeedFeedOrchestrator resolves material, check hypermill-materials-catalog.ts for alloy-specific machinability corrections (per-operation Vc/fz correction factors).
exit_conditions: Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

units.title: Wire POST-ULT 17-engine pipeline as final output stage for ALL pipelines
units.description: Every pipeline passes output through: PostPhysicsFoundation → LineByLineAdaptive (per-block S/F) → MotionControllerInjection (HSM/TCP/SSV) → PostVerificationSafety (MC verification) → PostOutputGeneration (controller dialect). This gives per-block variable S/F to everything.

units.title: Wire WEDM 12-engine pipeline into routing
units.description: QuoteToShipOrchestrator + MultiProcessCAMBridge route wire EDM to the REAL 20-stage pipeline (EDMDrawingInterpretation → EDMFeasibility → ... → EDMQualityOrchestrator), not old EDMProgramAssemblerEngine.
exit_conditions: Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

units.title: Wire SelfLearningCAMEngine + ProvenPartRecipeEngine
units.description: Every pipeline checks for proven recipes FIRST. After successful production, stores recipe. TransferLearningEngine for cold-start.
exit_conditions: Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

units.title: Wire DecisionTreeEngine into PipelineDecisionOrchestrator
units.description: For tool_select, strategy_select, coolant_select: use DecisionTree's 7 structured trees for step-by-step reasoning[] path. Every decision gets a logic trace.
exit_conditions: Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)
Typecheck clean: npx tsc --noEmit on touched files

units.title: Wire InferenceChainEngine for complex decisions
units.description: Multi-setup planning, process routing, strategy sequencing: use InferenceChain's analyzeAndRecommend + deepDiagnose patterns.
exit_conditions: Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)
Typecheck clean: npx tsc --noEmit on touched files

units.title: Wire XAIEngine into ALL pipeline outputs
units.description: SHAP-based feature importance: 'Strategy chosen 43% due to material hardness, 28% pocket depth, 17% RPM limit.' Users see WHY.
exit_conditions: Feature importance in every decision output
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)
Typecheck clean: npx tsc --noEmit on touched files

units.title: Wire 17 domain-specific optimization engines
units.description: DrillCycleOpt for drilling, StepoverOpt for milling, PeckDrillingOpt for deep holes, ToolMagazineOpt for turret layout, ZLevelOpt for roughing, TiltAngleOpt for 5-axis, CoolantCostOpt for coolant, ToolChangeOpt for tool order, FinishingPassOpt for finishing.
exit_conditions: Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)
Typecheck clean: npx tsc --noEmit on touched files

units.title: Wire 6 prediction engines into safety gates
units.description: QualityPrediction (Cpk), SurfaceFinishPredictor (real Ra), SurfaceIntegrityPredictor (white layer), ToolBreakagePrediction, ChatterPrediction, ProcessCapabilityPrediction → ALL feed SafetyVetoEngine.
exit_conditions: Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

units.title: Wire simulation gate before ALL output
units.description: CNCSimulationPipelineEngine as GATE. SimulationReportEngine in output. PredictiveFailureEngine identifies most dangerous block.
exit_conditions: Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

units.title: Wire ConvexOptimizationEngine for S/F optimization
units.description: Instead of Kienzle formula solve, formulate as: minimize cycle_time subject to Fc≤power×0.85, deflection≤tol/3, P(chatter)≤0.15. Find TRUE optimum.
exit_conditions: Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

units.title: Wire FuzzyLogicEngine for uncertain inputs
units.description: When hardness is a range (28-32 HRC), use fuzzy membership functions instead of midpoint. Propagate uncertainty through decisions.
exit_conditions: Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)
